name: Aethel Online
storyline:
Long ago, the world of Aethel was ruled by great kingdoms. Their cities of stone and timber spread across the continent, their caravans crossed it, their miners dug deep into the mountains and their sailors charted distant shores. Their watchtowers, keeps and sealed underground chambers still stand today.

Then came the Silence. The records of the Age of Kingdoms end abruptly. Trade routes vanished, armies disappeared and cities were abandoned, and no surviving account explains why. Some blame war, others plague, and some say forces long forgotten awakened beneath the earth. Civilization collapsed, and generations passed in uncertainty.

Now, in the age known as the Reclamation, survivors have rebuilt villages, cleared the old roads and restored trade. Vast regions remain unexplored, and adventurers set out from the settlements in search of opportunity and discovery. For many, the journey begins in Oakheart Vale, a frontier valley of forests, lakes and copper-rich hills that largely escaped the devastation. Yet ancient ruins lie hidden in its woods, strange carvings have been found beneath its old mine shafts, and travellers report lights moving through the forest after dark. The greatest mystery remains unanswered: what caused the Silence?
summary: Aethel Online is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG set on a handcrafted continent where every glade, mine and ruin is placed by hand. Centuries after the Silence ended the Age of Kingdoms, players explore the ruins of that lost era and level a wide range of interconnected gathering, crafting and combat skills, where each discipline feeds another. The economy is player-driven: nearly all gear is made by players and traded between them, not handed out by quests or shops. Progression is slow by design. Players can group into fellowships and clans, take on world events and boss encounters, and play across multiple worlds. An optional membership unlocks additional content. The game uses click-to-move controls and is distributed directly through its own launcher on Windows.
